citation.title: Real-time reflectometry – An ASDEX Upgrade DCS plugin App for plasma position and shape feedback control
citation.authors: J.M. Santos, L. Guimarães, C. Rapson, G. Santos, A. Silva, W. Treutterer, M. Zilker, ASDEX Upgrade Team, EUROfusion MST1 Team

topic: Real-time O-mode reflectometry density profiles and gaps integrated into the AUG discharge control system for position control.
own_question: Can a pipelined real-time reflectometry system deliver HFS/LFS gap estimates to the DCS fast enough to control the plasma geometric radius?
actual_method_and_evidence: The system uses a three-stage pipeline for acquisition, density-profile calculation and gap estimation with DCS delivery. The authors report a total latency of about 450 µs or less in benchmarking, and under 350 µs in four 2016 control discharges at a 1 ms delivery cycle. Reflectometry-based Rgeo stayed within about ±0.5 cm of the target trajectory, with cm-level offsets relative to the magnetic reconstruction. This is an electron-density diagnostic on AUG. It involves no CES, no ion temperature and no KSTAR data.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Diagnostic-derived quantities have been delivered to a tokamak control system in real time on a millisecond cycle; one example is reflectometry-based position control at AUG.
claim_checks.qualification: This example uses electron density, measured on a different machine. It does not cover ion temperature or nowcasting. The latency figures are the authors' own measurements and should not be transferred to our 10 ms computation.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Gap estimates from the current burst are delivered at 1 ms. This is direct measurement processing, not estimation of a delayed report.
validation_if_relevant: Accuracy was assessed by comparison with the magnetic reconstruction in four discharges. No held-out validation was performed.
forbidden_inferences: All prior real-time work is electron-only
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most an optional single citation to illustrate real-time integration of a diagnostic with plant control. It is not needed for the core CES nowcasting framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
